key_insight: Direct interpolation followed by constrained optimization enables minimally diffusive ALE remapping while enforcing physical bounds and global conservation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports high-order hydrodynamics simulations with large mesh displacements while conserving volume, mass, momentum, and total energy.
method: Transfer fields through direct physical-space interpolation rather than PDE-based advection.
Restore global conservation through optimization while preserving physical bounds.
Remap arbitrary-order finite element fields and integration-point quantities without intermediate projection.
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on standard 2D and 3D remap benchmarks and full ALE hydrodynamics simulations; the abstract provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: The scalability and computational cost of the conservation-restoring optimization require assessment for large production simulations.
paper_title: Remap for ALE Hydrodynamics via Direct Interpolation and Constraint Optimization
